cd /workspace/project && python3 -B - <<'PY'
from modules.byte_program import *
import random
random.seed(33)
values=[(None,b'')]
for z in range(18000):
 op=random.randrange(4)
 if op==0:
  raw=bytes(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(random.randrange(50)))
  v=literal(raw)
 elif op==1:
  a,rawa=random.choice(values); b,rawb=random.choice(values)
  if len(rawa)+len(rawb)>200000: continue
  raw=rawa+rawb; v=concat(a,b)
 elif op==2:
  a,rawa=random.choice(values); count=random.randrange(50)
  if len(rawa)*count>200000: continue
  raw=rawa*count; v=repeat(a,count)
 else:
  a,rawa=random.choice(values)
  lo=random.randrange(len(rawa)+1); hi=random.randrange(lo,len(rawa)+1)
  raw=rawa[lo:hi]; v=cut(a,lo,hi)
 assert size(v)==len(raw)
 assert materialize(v,200000)==raw,(op,size(v))
 assert fingerprint(v)==fingerprint(literal(raw)),(z,op)
 for i in range(3):
  lo=random.randrange(len(raw)+1); hi=random.randrange(lo,len(raw)+1)
  assert read(v,lo,hi,200000)==raw[lo:hi],(op,lo,hi)
  assert next_lf(v,lo)==raw.find(b'\n',lo),(op,lo)
 if len(values)>1000: values.pop(random.randrange(len(values)))
 values.append((v,raw))
print('random rope tests passed')
# Many chained sharing operations, both directions and repeated slices.
x=literal(b'x'); y=x
for z in range(8192):
 x=concat(x,literal(b'a')); y=concat(literal(b'b'),y)
assert materialize(x)==b'x'+b'a'*8192
assert materialize(y)==b'b'*8192+b'x'
x=repeat(concat(x,y),10**12)
assert next_lf(x)==-1
for start in [0,1,8192,16386,10**16]:
 assert len(read(x,start,start+65536))==65536
print('long rope tests passed')
PY
